main.description: UNCONFIRMED / best-effort shape — flag this before relying on it. The collection name net.bisks.hyperobject.cast is declared as a constant in public/index.html (CAST_COLLECTION) and referenced only in a comment ("Only isolyth.dev can cast directly (Worker-enforced — see src/index.ts's /api/cast gate)"), but no code in this site actually calls com.atproto.repo.createRecord or putRecord for this collection: castInto() only writes to browser localStorage (key "hyperobject.pit"), and src/index.ts is a bare static-asset passthrough with no /api/cast route at all. This lexicon is inferred from the localStorage "entry" object castInto() builds (did/handle/displayName/avatar/note) as a guess at what a real PDS-backed record would hold if this feature is ever finished — it is NOT derived from an actual write call and should be confirmed with whoever finishes the cast/suggestion feature before being treated as ground truth. Presumed to be written by isolyth.dev (the only account allowed to cast directly, per the UI copy) to her own repo. Read by hyperobject (https://hyperobject.bisks.net), if implemented.

subject.description: DID of the account cast into the pit. Inferred from castInto()'s local `entry.did`; unconfirmed as an actual record field.

note.description: Optional free-text note entered alongside the cast, mirroring the `note` field on castInto()'s local-only entry object. Unconfirmed as an actual record field.

createdAt.description: When the cast happened, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
